'''Kinash Lock''' was a [[Color|red]]-skinned [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|male]] who served as the [[majordomo]] to [[King]] [[Yaruba]] of [[Kessel]] and the [[Yaruba Family of Kessel]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In the name of the king, he negotiated a deal with [[Rafa Martez]] to transport [[spice]] to [[Marg Krim]] of the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on [[Oba Diah]].<ref name="Deal No Deal" /> Rafa and [[Trace Martez|Trace]]' task was dangerous and both of them lacked the experience Lock's assignment required.<ref name="TCWE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Kinash Lock was a red-skinned Twi'lek male who served as the who served as the majordomo to King Yaruba of Kessel and the Yaruba Family of Kessel during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Deal No Deal" /> Lock was 1.9 [[meter]]s, or 6 [[Foot|feet]], 3 inches tall,<ref name="TCWE" /> with red [[eye]]s and red skin.<ref name="Deal No Deal" /> He supervised trades for Yaruba, which gave him the chance to strike deals with smugglers in the king's name.<ref name="TCWE" /> Lock was also a calm and deliberate speaker.<ref name="Deal No Deal" />

==Skills and abilities==
As King Yaruba's majordomo, Kinash Lock was an experienced bureaucrat. He also was skilled at persuasion, smuggling and negotiations.<ref name="TCWE" />

==Equipment==
Lock wore fancy clothing as well as a [[Color|gold]] and blue headpiece.<ref name="Deal No Deal" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kinash Lock first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Deal No Deal]]."<ref name="Deal No Deal" />
